text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is upon us once more this year.
Eager to witness history just like last year,
racing fans from all over the country have gathered—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Another star-studded lineup! I'm super hyped!
Maybe we'll witness a new legend being born...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate showdown between peers of the Tiara line, huh?
It looks like it's gonna be an incredible race, just like last year...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Just what kind of race will this turn out to be?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...All right, Trainer, if you would.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me. I'll be the most eye-catching one in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, why are you heading into
the paddock?! You're not an Umamusume!
choice_data_list: Do your best again today~! Lucky Lilac~!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay.
Thanks for cheering so loudly~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're not even a fan!!
Did you forget what your actual job is!?
choice_data_list: Ah, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!
Ah, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You really had amnesia!?
Wait, does that mean you forgot about me too—
choice_data_list: Of course I remember! The Queen, Lucky Lilac!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Look, as expected, you forgo—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're NOT gonna do it?!!
You're not gonna play the straight man there?!
choice_data_list: Even if I go senile, I could never forget you.
Even if I go senile, I could never forget you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, my, aren't you quite the smooth talker!
Enough already!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Comedy hour was over with the last bit.
Please don't put it in the past tense.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm going to
bloom even more brilliantly."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.
choice_data_list: I'll be there to watch you become the star.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, there's one thing.
Just let me say this.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I respect Lala
from the bottom of my heart."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You are an Umamusume who quietly, resolutely,
continues to hone yourself in pursuit of greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, remaining dignified and unchanged,
continuing to exist as the "Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will defeat you—
the one who is always so wonderful and cool!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...You're praising me way too much.
I've never even beaten you before, Ai-san."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And yet, here we are right now, facing each other.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: She's looking straight at me, as if saying, 'I'm going to win today'...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That reason alone is more than enough
for why I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
That's so like Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Come now, it's about time to get going, Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Today, I am going to――――WIN!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......I accept your direct challenge.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Today's finally my turn.

text_block_list.text: The one who's gonna win today... is me.
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...To some folks,
I might just look like an unlucky Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Because I'm a contemporary of a light so dazzling, it'll surely be talked about for generations to come.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Still――as far as I'm concerned, it's the exact opposite.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm lucky. A truly fortunate person. I mean, it's true, right?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (The supreme flower, one that even the greatest light in history can never outshine.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm the only one who can become like that!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Now, it's time to bloom.
